helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-MCMSS-CRF-009.2 - Changes required in CSV file format As per the changes delivered against Pharmacy CRF (MO-MCMSS-CRF-0009 & 0009.1), sharing prescription details to 3rd party in CSV format having issues in the format which are to be corrected. Please refer to the attached csv file generated form EM and sample csv file received from vendor. Corrections required in CSV format generated from EM HIS: CSV file should not contain header details (File generated from EM has header information). One csv file to be created for each order id, one csv file for one order id irrespective of single medication multiple medication in the order. When there is no data present, currently EM is sending as â€˜nullâ€™, it should be blank (refer sample csv file provided by vendor for the same). Patient Name & English Name â€“ both should be in English (no need to send local language) Take time â€“ can be always blank Freq_counter: Currently display with description, like â€˜1/6: Every 6 Hoursâ€™, but it should display only â€˜1/6â€™. Sample details are provided below for various cases: 1/1: one time /every day 2/1: Two times/every day 3/1: Three times /every day 1/2: one time /every two days 2/3: Two times/every three days 1/7: One time/ once a week
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MO-MCMSS-CRF-009.2 - Changes required in CSV file format
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
MO-MCMSS-CRF-009.2 - Changes required in CSV file format
As per the changes delivered against Pharmacy CRF (MO-MCMSS-CRF-0009 & 0009.1), sharing prescription details to 3rd party in CSV format having issues in the format which are to be corrected.
Please refer to the attached csv file generated form EM and sample csv file received from vendor.
Corrections required in CSV format generated from EM HIS:
  1. CSV file should not contain header details (File generated from EM has header information).
  2. One csv file to be created for each order id, one csv file for one order id irrespective of single medication multiple medication in the order.
  3. When there is no data present, currently EM is sending as â€˜nullâ€™, it should be blank (refer sample csv file provided by vendor for the same).
  4. Patient Name & English Name â€“ both should be in English (no need to send local language)
  5. Take time â€“ can be always blank
  6. Freq_counter: Currently display with description, like â€˜1/6: Every 6 Hoursâ€™, but it should display only â€˜1/6â€™. Sample details are provided below for various cases:
1/1: one time /every day
2/1: Two times/every day
3/1: Three times /every day
1/2: one time /every two days
2/3: Two times/every three days
1/7: One time/ once a week

helpdesk-ticket.description: In the Lab module, while defining an age/sex/method-based reference range, one of the fields included is the Critical Range. However, in actual lab practice, defining a critical range is not mandatory for all tests or methods. Currently, the system enforces a restriction where a reference range cannot be saved unless a value is entered in the Critical Range field. As a workaround, we are entering dummy values in this field to proceed, and later manually removing them from the backend. This is an issue and not ideal and introduces unnecessary steps and potential for data inconsistency. Request: Please make the Critical Range field optional during reference range configuration to align with real-world lab workflows and ensure smoother data entry. Â

helpdesk-ticket.description: However this functionality does not meet the requirements for panel patients i.e. CGHS, ECHS, Ayushman Bharat and Haryana Government where in general all Pharmacy items are part of packages. According to the current system functionality if any item is part of a package, it will not display in bill. As per Haryana Govt. requirements, Discharge Medication has to be provided to patient during patient discharge. Discharge Medication should be either for 7 days or less than Rs 2000. Â Â As part of this requirement, we need following changes in existing functionality: System should identify Discharge Medication items (HOME_MEDICATION_YN=â€™Yâ€™ in Folio or Package Folio) and consider then always as Package Exclusion Item. Phase -1 Home Medication is actually a Future order and should be part of packages. However we can have an option in package definition to include it in package if there is any specific needs. This can be address in Phase -2. System should have a parameter for define Amount limit for Discharge Medication. Currently there is a limit for Rs 2000 only. System should not allow to add discharge medication more than define amount limit. Phase -2. This is raised as non-compliance and Haryana Govt. now stop processing payments. We need this feature (point no 1) on urgent basic. For point no 2 and 3 can be manage for now. Â As per current functionality, system is not validating Home Medication flag and including items part of packages if limit is there. Â Also there is no provision to configure home medication items in package definition function or Maintain Treatment Package function Â Please include new validation to identify Home Medication items (HOME_MEDICATION_YN=â€™Yâ€™) and exclude them from package always. Â We will update INCL_HOME_MEDICATION_YN =â€™Nâ€™ for all existing packages in following tables. Â BL_PACKAGE_DTLS BL_PACKAGE_COVERAGE_FOR_BG
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Enhancement in Package Inclusion/Exclusion Logic for Home Medication Items
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
However this functionality does not meet the requirements for panel patients i.e. CGHS, ECHS, Ayushman Bharat and Haryana Government where in general all Pharmacy items are part of packages.
According to the current system functionality if any item is part of a package, it will not display in bill.
As per Haryana Govt. requirements, Discharge Medication has to be provided to patient during patient discharge. Discharge Medication should be either for 7 days or less than Rs 2000. Â Â 
As part of this requirement, we need following changes in existing functionality:
  1. System should identify Discharge Medication items (HOME_MEDICATION_YN=â€™Yâ€™ in Folio or Package Folio) and consider then always as Package Exclusion Item. Phase -1
  2. Home Medication is actually a Future order and should be part of packages. However we can have an option in package definition to include it in package if there is any specific needs. This can be address in Phase -2.
  3. System should have a parameter for define Amount limit for Discharge Medication. Currently there is a limit for Rs 2000 only. System should not allow to add discharge medication more than define amount limit. Phase -2.
This is raised as non-compliance and Haryana Govt. now stop processing payments.
We need this feature (point no 1) on urgent basic. For point no 2 and 3 can be manage for now.
Â 
As per current functionality, system is not validating Home Medication flag and including items part of packages if limit is there.
Â 
Also there is no provision to configure home medication items in package definition function or Maintain Treatment Package function
Â 
Please include new validation to identify Home Medication items (HOME_MEDICATION_YN=â€™Yâ€™) and exclude them from package always.
Â 
We will update INCL_HOME_MEDICATION_YN =â€™Nâ€™ for all existing packages in following tables.
Â 
BL_PACKAGE_DTLS
BL_PACKAGE_COVERAGE_FOR_BG

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Enhancement require in Package Subscription function. The requirement is to have Quantity like billing service in Package Subscription and price should display after multiplying quantity. Rest all logic should continue as it is. User can insert quantity in decimal form like 0.5 or 0.25 qty. Quantity column should also be available in Maintain Treatment Package function (Non editable).
Â Currently we have provision to add package but there is no quantity column and system by default consider single quantity. In current system, it allows to change the package base price during package subscription which is not correct as it reflect as package price in bl_package_sub_dhr table. Even in bill it prints modified price but quantity is 1 only. As per business requirement, if there is more than one surgery performed in single seating then we should charge half price/tariff for 2nd surgery onwards. Even there is policy to charge one fourth for few cases. Now to handle such requirement, currently users are editing/modifying the package amount during subscription but due to new features (delivered through March 2024 release) system is recalculating package price based on billing group selected and during recalculation as there is no quantity, it is charging full package amount for all packages which is wrong. So we need to have a qty column in package subscription function and user should be able to modify it based on needs (i.e. 0.5 qty or 0.25 qty) and system should consider quantity during every calculation. Please consider max 2 decimal digit for modifying package quantity. The requirement for quantity modification is for 2nd package onwards hence please allow quantity modification only if users are subscribing more than one package in same encounter. Â To add a quantity option for the package subscription page which might calculate the tariff according to the prices set according to the Billing group/ specific financial details

So we need to have a qty column in package subscription function and user should be able to modify it based on needs (i.e. 0.5 qty or 0.25 qty) and system should consider quantity during every calculation.
Please consider max 2 decimal digit for modifying package quantity.
The requirement for quantity modification is for 2nd package onwards hence please allow quantity modification only if users are subscribing more than one package in same encounter. Â

helpdesk-ticket.description: HL7 messages are triggered correctly during the initial registration of a radiology study, however, when the study location is revised or changed afterward e.g., due to modality availability, the HIS does not send the updated HL7 message, and the status remains unchanged. This should be changed as soon as the modality location is being changed from HIS. Currently Message is not generating after changing the modality in HIS (Radiology Module). The workflow involves an order registration being done with location LCT2 and subsequently modified to LCT1 from HIS, the modified location is not getting updated.Â Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-CRF-0727: To address the gap in HL7 interface when radiology study location is changed or modified
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
HL7 messages are triggered correctly during the initial registration of a radiology study, however, when the study location is revised or changed afterward e.g., due to modality availability, the HIS does not send the updated HL7 message, and the status remains unchanged. This should be changed as soon as the modality location is being changed from HIS.
Currently Message is not generating after changing the modality in HIS (Radiology Module).
The workflow involves an order registration being done with location LCT2 and subsequently modified to LCT1 from HIS, the modified location is not getting updated.Â 
Â

This CRF is raised to address the issue raised in GHL-SCF-1924 therein the issue was:Â
Â
In HIS, we have the "Post-Discharge Modify Financial Details" functionality that allows us to modify billing groups and update company approval amounts in the bill after patient has been discharged from the system. This functionality is working perfectly in non-package bill scenarios.Â Â
However, in the case of package bills, the process is failing, and we are unable to generate the correct bill under charges.Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: RBU-GHL-CRF-0072: Post discharge Modify financial detail functionality should work same way it is working for non-package cases.

Â

Â 
However, in the case of package bills, the process is failing, and we are unable to generate the correct bill under charges.Â

helpdesk-ticket.description:
MedDream PACS from Softneta is being implemented at SSSIHMS. Migration from existing Synapse PACS to MedDream PACS is in progress. The new requirement is to integrate Enterprise Management (EM) to MedDream PACS similar to the current functionality provided for Synapse PACS. Additionally MedDream RIS will be used by external f radiologists and internal radiologists will continue to use Â Dedalus RIS for reporting. In this scenario we have the below requirements.
All existing HL7 messaging to existing Synapse pacs to be replicated with MedDream PACS.
PACS Virewer integration to be chaged from existing Synapse PACS to MedDream PACS
Patient history to be passed on from EM to MedDream PACS/RIS on order completion.Â
Exams reported usingÂ MedDream RIS to be updated into EM accordingly based on the statuses viz Dictated, Finalized, Modified
All existing HL7 messaging to Synapse to continue
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Meddream PACS Integration with EM (SS-CRF-20070)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
MedDream PACS from Softneta is being implemented at SSSIHMS. Migration from existing Synapse PACS to MedDream PACS is in progress. The new requirement is to integrate Enterprise Management (EM) to MedDream PACS similar to the current functionality provided for Synapse PACS.
Additionally MedDream RIS will be used by external f radiologists and internal radiologists will continue to use Â Dedalus RIS for reporting. In this scenario we have the below requirements.
  • All existing HL7 messaging to existing Synapse pacs to be replicated with MedDream PACS.
  • PACS Virewer integration to be chaged from existing Synapse PACS to MedDream PACS
  • Patient history to be passed on from EM to MedDream PACS/RIS on order completion.Â 
  • Exams reported usingÂ  MedDream RIS to be updated into EM accordingly based on the statuses viz Dictated, Finalized, Modified
  • All existing HL7 messaging to Synapse to continue

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber, As of today, Bioflash has successfully Go Live. Based on observation today, we have found that the order that has been transmitted from LIS to Bioflash has been removed from Pending Worklist after they complete the QC. As of that, new flow is suggested. Order: 1. User needs to run QC at analyzer. ​2. After QC completed, they need to do transmit batch to analyzer to resend the order to analyzer. 3. Then, they can arrange sample in the sample loader with barcode facing the scanner area. ​4. Then sample will run as usual. Result: ​1. All negative result will transmitted directly to LIS once result completed. 2. Postive results required user to do manual validation at analyzer. So far order and result is transmitted correctly. As of today, I will resolved this ticket since we have completed the implementation. If user encounter any issue, please log new ticket to us. ​Please send the FAT sign off to us. Thanks a lot for your great help during the implementation. ​ Regards, AdeaHub Norhaiza Onn Senior Profesional Application & Technical Deployment Management m: +6014 337 5099 e: nonn2@adeahub.co
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber,

As of today, Bioflash has successfully Go Live.
Based on observation today, we have found that the order that has been transmitted from LIS to Bioflash has been removed from Pending Worklist after they complete the QC. As of that, new flow is suggested.

Order: 

1. User needs to run QC at analyzer. 
​2. After QC completed, they need to do transmit batch to analyzer to resend the order to analyzer.
3. Then, they can arrange sample in the sample loader with barcode facing the scanner area.
​4. Then sample will run as usual.

Result:
​1. All negative result will transmitted directly to LIS once result completed.
2. Postive results required user to do manual validation at analyzer.

So far order and result is transmitted correctly. As of today, I will resolved this ticket since we have completed the implementation.
If user encounter any issue, please log new ticket to us.
​Please send the FAT sign off to us.

Thanks a lot for your great help during the implementation.
​

Regards,
AdeaHub

Senior Profesional Application & Technical Deployment Management

helpdesk-ticket.description:
This request is to escalate an ongoing issue regarding frequent network disconnections that are critically disrupting operations within the Pathology Department, specifically the Chemical Pathology Unit. Despite efforts to manage the situation, the problem remains unresolved and continues to cause significant delays. The key issues are as follows:
Frequent Network Disconnections All interfaces within the Pathology Department experience regular network disconnections, with the Chemical Pathology Unit being the most severely impacted. The root cause of these disconnections has yet to be identified, and until this is addressed, the problem is likely to persist.
Operational Issues Following Network Recovery After network restoration, results fail to transmit, and samples are not recognized by the analyzers. This necessitates manual transmission of patient samples to the analyzer, significantly slowing down the process. This method is inefficient, particularly given the high volume of daily samples. An alternative, more efficient solution is required to ensure that operations can continue without delay.
Immediate action is requested to identify the cause of the disconnections and provide a long-term resolution for both the network and post-recovery transmission issues. Additionally, guidance on potential timelines for these fixes would be appreciated. This situation is critically impacting daily operations, and a prompt resolution is necessary.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Analyzer Not Transmitting Results Due to Network Disruptions
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
This request is to escalate an ongoing issue regarding frequent network disconnections that are critically disrupting operations within the Pathology Department, specifically the Chemical Pathology Unit. Despite efforts to manage the situation, the problem remains unresolved and continues to cause significant delays.
The key issues are as follows:
  1. Frequent Network Disconnections
    All interfaces within the Pathology Department experience regular network disconnections, with the Chemical Pathology Unit being the most severely impacted. The root cause of these disconnections has yet to be identified, and until this is addressed, the problem is likely to persist.
  2. Operational Issues Following Network Recovery
    After network restoration, results fail to transmit, and samples are not recognized by the analyzers. This necessitates manual transmission of patient samples to the analyzer, significantly slowing down the process. This method is inefficient, particularly given the high volume of daily samples. An alternative, more efficient solution is required to ensure that operations can continue without delay.
Immediate action is requested to identify the cause of the disconnections and provide a long-term resolution for both the network and post-recovery transmission issues. Additionally, guidance on potential timelines for these fixes would be appreciated.
This situation is critically impacting daily operations, and a prompt resolution is necessary.

helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Abdul Bari Yusoff,

Regarding this issue, we are unable to unmerge the encounter for the IP patient, as this activity involves multiple tables in the system.
As a workaround, we suggest that the MRD user utilize the Printing EMR Patient Wise - CA function (please refer to the attached document for screenshot reference):
  1. The user should filter using the patient ID (WCH0331330) along with the date range of the patient’s visit. The system will display the details by section. The user can then select the relevant sections and print them for BHT filing purposes.
  2. Deactivate the patient ID WCH0331330.
  3. Create a new patient ID for the patient name: Unknown (Cing Ngaih Hau). The user may attach the hardcopy (BHT file) in the system under clinical notes.
 
Regards,
AdeaHub

Aida Binti Jamat
Professional Application Delivery

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Abdul Bari Yusoff, As an advice, we need to enforce the registration users (Unit HASIL) to check the patient’s details carefully before registering to avoid mistakes like this. They should first identify the correct patient who needs to be registered, whether it is the baby or the baby’s mother. Babies also have their own MyKid. Please ensure that the clerk updates the baby’s MyKid number in the MyKad/MyKid section. This way, when the patient comes again in the future and does not remember the patient ID, the staff can search using the MyKid number instead of using the mother’s IC to find the patient ID. Based on this suggestion or solution, we can help prevent similar cases from happening again in the future. Regards, AdeaHub Aida Binti Jamat Professional Application Delivery
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Abdul Bari Yusoff,

As an advice, we need to enforce the registration users (Unit HASIL) to check the patient’s details carefully before registering to avoid mistakes like this. They should first identify the correct patient who needs to be registered, whether it is the baby or the baby’s mother.

Babies also have their own MyKid. Please ensure that the clerk updates the baby’s MyKid number in the MyKad/MyKid section. This way, when the patient comes again in the future and does not remember the patient ID, the staff can search using the MyKid number instead of using the mother’s IC to find the patient ID.

Based on this suggestion or solution, we can help prevent similar cases from happening again in the future.

Regards,
AdeaHub

Aida Binti Jamat
Professional Application Delivery

helpdesk-note.body: Thank you for the suggestion. However, if the mother forget to bring the baby’s MyKid number, how can we check or retrieve the patient’s details in the system? Kindly advise on the alternative method to search for the patient record. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ We would like to report an incident involving incorrect patient registration at ED Counter and seek your assistance in reviewing the system behavior and recommending preventive measures. 2023 1. A 21-year-old woman delivered a baby boy as a Baby Born Before Arrival (BBA) in January 2023. The newborn was admitted to the Neonatal and discharged on 04/01/2023. 2024 2. The same patient (mother) was admitted to the hospital and delivered another baby boy on 06/04/2024. The newborn was delivered in good condition and discharged home. 2025 3. The patient (mother) presented to the Emergency Department (ED) with her child for medical treatment. During registration at the ED counter, the child was registered using the mother’s identification card (IC) by selecting “Other Alt Type: Mother IC” and entering the IC number under “Other Alt No.” ED counter staff incorrectly registered the child under the existing BBA record from January 2023, instead of the correct record for the child born in April 2024. Mother had actually brought her second child (born April 2024) to the ED. For your information, both children were still registered under the default name “Baby of” Based on the scenario above, We would appreciate your assistance in: Why the system detected only one child linked to the mother’s IC. Recommendations or solutions to prevent similar cases from occurring in the future.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Thank you for the suggestion.
However, if the mother forget to bring the baby’s MyKid number, how can we check or retrieve the patient’s details in the system?
Kindly advise on the alternative method to search for the patient record.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We would like to report an incident involving incorrect patient registration at ED Counter and seek your assistance in reviewing the system behavior and recommending preventive measures.
2023
1. A 21-year-old woman delivered a baby boy as a Baby Born Before Arrival (BBA) in January 2023. The newborn was admitted to the Neonatal and discharged on 04/01/2023.
2024
2. The same patient (mother) was admitted to the hospital and delivered another baby boy on 06/04/2024. The newborn was delivered in good condition and discharged home.
2025
3. The patient (mother) presented to the Emergency Department (ED) with her child for medical treatment.
During registration at the ED counter, the child was registered using the mother’s identification card (IC) by selecting “Other Alt Type: Mother IC” and entering the IC number under “Other Alt No.”
ED counter staff incorrectly registered the child under the existing BBA record from January 2023, instead of the correct record for the child born in April 2024.
Mother had actually brought her second child (born April 2024) to the ED. For your information, both children were still registered under the default name “Baby of”
Based on the scenario above, We would appreciate your assistance in:
  1. Why the system detected only one child linked to the mother’s IC.
  2. Recommendations or solutions to prevent similar cases from occurring in the future.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Abdul Bari Yusoff, ​ This depends on whether the baby’s details have already been updated in the system using the “Change Patient Details” function under Head of Family Patient ID / Head of Family Patient Name. However, if there is no MyKid record in the system, we will not be able to check or retrieve the baby’s details. Otherwise, if the mother forgets to bring the baby’s MyKid, please ask her to provide the baby’s MyKid number verbally. Alternatively, she may refer to the MySejahtera application and obtain the baby’s information from the “Dependents – Manage Dependents” section. Regards, AdeaHub Aida Binti Jamat Professional Application Delivery
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Abdul Bari Yusoff,
​
This depends on whether the baby’s details have already been updated in the system using the “Change Patient Details” function under Head of Family Patient ID / Head of Family Patient Name. However, if there is no MyKid record in the system, we will not be able to check or retrieve the baby’s details.

Otherwise, if the mother forgets to bring the baby’s MyKid, please ask her to provide the baby’s MyKid number verbally. Alternatively, she may refer to the MySejahtera application and obtain the baby’s information from the “Dependents – Manage Dependents” section.

Regards,
AdeaHub

Aida Binti Jamat
Professional Application Delivery

helpdesk-ticket.description: In case patient is of GIPSA or other selected TPA /Corporate and more than 1 surgery are done in the same time the high cost surgery will be charged @ 100% and the 2nd small amount surgery will be charged as 50% of its rate, and 3rd will be charged at 25% of its rate (Hospital Tariff or as per the contract tariff entered in i-soft system). This is as per current arrangement with GIPSA. This is related to more than 1 surgery done at the same episode and as per gipsa the 1st surgery (highest category surgery) will be charged @100%, 2nd surgery @50% (lower category than 1st surgery) and for 3rd surgery @25%

helpdesk-ticket.description: Deposit - Carry Forward 1) Currently, patient specific excess deposit is not allowed to be Carry forward to next admission or for OPD episode. (i.e. say If 5 patients are having excess deposit and out of which only 2 says they want to carry forward than system is not allowing to do so) 2) A) KH requires, it should be allowed to carry forward (patient specific) to next admission or can be used for OPD episode, if the refund of the excess amount is not given to patient. B) Also, in the discharge bill it should show the amount that the patient has carry forward the excess amount and the same should be reflected in the next episode of the patient under the description brought forward and its amount. Note: System should allow either whole or part of the refund amount to be carried forward to the next episode.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Deposit - Carry Forward
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Deposit - Carry Forward
1) Currently, patient specific excess deposit is not allowed to be Carry forward to next admission or for OPD episode. (i.e. say If 5 patients are having excess deposit and out of which only 2 says they want to carry forward than system is not allowing to do so)
2) A) KH requires, it should be allowed to carry forward (patient specific) to next admission or can be used for OPD episode, if the refund of the excess amount is not given to patient.
B) Also, in the discharge bill it should show the amount that the patient has carry forward the excess amount and the same should be reflected in the next episode of the patient under the description brought forward and its amount.
Note: System should allow either whole or part of the refund amount to be carried forward to the next episode.

Person has prepared the bill and then cancelled but not completed the entire cancellation process and due to which the original bill is showing as recoverable from NACIL
We wanted to have mandatory bill closure once it is cancelled, it cannot be staying in bill cum receipt.
As I see based on the details provided, following has happened:
1. Visit created and bill is generated.
2. Visit cancelled and hence negative entry flowed, and bill is pending to be generated. Bill generated during visit creation was not cancelled and hence showing up as Not cancelled as identified by you.

helpdesk-ticket.description: We have defined GIPSA tariff and there is Stat charges of 25%, so same is also defined in max column / service amt limit of i-soft software due to limitation of software. 1) Due to which if any service is given in emergency the system calculates incorrect discount and also the display is not coming on the bill ((gipsa discount not getting displayed for many of servicesÂ having stat charges applicable- 14/10/20 with bill sample)) 2) Also if we the stat charges we defined after considering the discount than the same is not accepted by the gipsa and gipsa again deducts the discount while settling the bill
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GIPSA stat charges-discount issue
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We have defined GIPSA tariff and there is Stat charges of 25%, so same is also defined in max column / service amt limit of i-soft software due to limitation of software.
1) Due to which if any service is given in emergency the system calculates incorrect discount and also the display is not coming on the bill ((gipsa discount not getting displayed for many of servicesÂ  having stat charges applicable- 14/10/20 with bill sample))
2) Also if we the stat charges we defined after considering the discount than the same is not accepted by the gipsa and gipsa again deducts the discount while settling the bill

helpdesk-ticket.description:
NEFT Payment need to happen and after the payment happens a Receipt need to be generated in the HIS system against the patient. Please find below the functional requirements for the integration of NEFT payment with the HIS: Virtual Account Number Generation Each patient must be assigned a unique virtual account number. The format of the virtual account number will be based on the facility code concatenated with the patient's UHID. Examples for different locations: Andheri Facility: KDAHMUKH1000063099 Navi Mumbai Facility: KDAHNMRH1000063099 Indore Facility: KDAHINKHI00063099
Display of Virtual Account Number The virtual account number should be displayed in the admission form. It should also appear in all billing-related reports, preferably at the bottom of the document for clarity and easy reference. NEFT Payment Flow and Integration Patients should be able to view their virtual account number and proceed to the NEFT payment page. After the NEFT transaction, the payment should be received by HIS, where the system should identify the patient using the UHID embedded in the virtual account number. Upon successful identification and validation, a deposit receipt must be auto generated and reflected in the patientâ€™s billing account within the HIS. API Integration Please refer to the attached API documentation for technical details required for integrating the NEFT functionality with HIS in the references section.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NEFT Payment and Receipt Generation (CRF- 710)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
NEFT Payment need to happen and after the payment happens a Receipt need to be generated in the HIS system against the patient.
Please find below the functional requirements for the integration of NEFT payment with the HIS:
  1. Virtual Account Number Generation
    • Each patient must be assigned a unique virtual account number.
    • The format of the virtual account number will be based on the facility code concatenated with the patient's UHID.
    • Examples for different locations:
      • Andheri Facility: KDAHMUKH1000063099
      • Navi Mumbai Facility: KDAHNMRH1000063099
      • Indore Facility: KDAHINKHI00063099
  2. Display of Virtual Account Number
    • The virtual account number should be displayed in the admission form.
    • It should also appear in all billing-related reports, preferably at the bottom of the document for clarity and easy reference.
  3. NEFT Payment Flow and Integration
    • Patients should be able to view their virtual account number and proceed to the NEFT payment page.
    • After the NEFT transaction, the payment should be received by HIS, where the system should identify the patient using the UHID embedded in the virtual account number.
    • Upon successful identification and validation, a deposit receipt must be auto generated and reflected in the patientâ€™s billing account within the HIS.
  4. API Integration
Please refer to the attached API documentation for technical details required for integrating the NEFT functionality with HIS in the references section.

helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-CRF-20237 - Pharmacy Register Order Changes In Pharmacy Register Order Function, currently patients order details are grouped by Patient and visit location. When patient is having multiple visit in the single day, unable to complete the Registration by selecting all orders related to the patient one time. We need option to display all patientâ€™s orders together and selected all orders by default. So pharmacist shall review and unselect any medications and then complete the registration in a single click. On loading function should refresh automatic and show all prescriptions by default. Function should Refresh automatic for every given minutes/seconds. This will mainly help the pharmacist to generate single token number and avoid multiple tokens for single patient.

helpdesk-ticket.description: We would like to thank you for the efforts in implementation of E-Invoicing in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This email is to inform you about important updates released vide SDK V3.3.4 particularly on the .Net SDK.Â Kindly note that ZATCA has updated .Net SDK to support latest versions of .Net Core 3.1 and .Net Core 8.0 and also the .Net Framework is upgraded from 4 to 4.8 to align with the latest version. If you use .Net SDK, please make sure to upgrade to the latest versions of .Net Core and .Net Framework.Â For this release, we have published SDK in two versions, however, from next release ZATCA will maintain only the latest version of .Net Core and .Net Framework. helpdesk-ticket.description: When an insurance visit is registered with a specific pre-approval amount capping, then if the amount of the total service exceeded the capping amount then need to send all services for pre-approvals not only the exceeded services Â Example: let's say that we created anÂ insurance policy as below, then it was associated with a new patient and new encounter created for him, the doctor placedÂ 5 LAB services for him as below. 1- CBC (300 SAR) 2- Lipid Profile (400 SAR) 3- Vitamin D (250Â SAR) 4- Iron (100 SAR) 5- TSHÂ (200 SAR) Current behavior: TheÂ System will auto-approve services 1 & 2 only, and will send all remaining services 3 & 4 & 5 for the pre-approval stage. The expected behavior as requested by the business: is to send ALL those LAB services for the pre-approval stage since the amount of the total service exceeded 1000 SAR. Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: When an insurance visit is registered with a specific pre-approval amount capping, then if the amount of the total service exceeded the capping amount then need to send all services for pre-approvals
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
When an insurance visit is registered with a specific pre-approval amount capping, then if the amount of the total service exceeded the capping amount then need to send all services for pre-approvals not only the exceeded services
Â 
Example: let's say that we created anÂ insurance policy as below, then it was associated with a new patient and new encounter created for him, the doctor placedÂ 5 LAB services for him as below.
1- CBC (300 SAR)
2- Lipid Profile (400 SAR)
3- Vitamin D (250Â SAR)
4- Iron (100 SAR)
5- TSHÂ  (200 SAR)
Current behavior: TheÂ System will auto-approve services 1 & 2 only, and will send all remaining services 3 & 4 & 5 for the pre-approval stage.
The expected behavior as requested by the business: is to send ALL those LAB services for the pre-approval stage since the amount of the total service exceeded 1000 SAR.
Â

helpdesk-ticket.description: Currently we have some OR order catalog duplicate check rules in-place, and it's working well. But it caused us many issue cause it's applies for CASH / Insurance patients specially whome come later asking for CASH order set, Â below steps how this issue is happening with us. Insured patients registered, he got HBA1C or Lipid Profile placed and resulted. After 1 month, patient came to clinic to follow-up his HBA1C or Lipid Profile order catalog in CASH, Â (Cause insurance companies will not allow those multiple orders in less than 90 days). Â So the patient seeking to check his HBA1C or Lipid Profile on his own payment (CASH), so we should allow him for this. We need to have a way to overcome the order duplicate check, in case of CASH encounters. Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: For CASH patients (CASH encounters), we need to bypass OR Duplicate Check Rules
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Currently we have some OR order catalog duplicate check rules in-place, and it's working well.
But it caused us many issue cause it's applies for CASH / Insurance patients specially whome come later asking for CASH order set, Â below steps how this issue is happening with us.
  1. Insured patients registered, he got HBA1C or Lipid Profile placed and resulted.
  2. After 1 month, patient came to clinic to follow-up his HBA1C or Lipid Profile order catalog in CASH, Â (Cause insurance companies will not allow those multiple orders in less than 90 days).
  3. Â So the patient seeking to check his HBA1C or Lipid Profile on his own payment (CASH), so we should allow him for this.
We need to have a way to overcome the order duplicate check, in case of CASH encounters.
Â

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Nur Fadzilah Othman, In today’s session, we explained the behavior of the Special Food Items and Food Dislikes functions in the Testing Instance. Currently, the setup and configuration allow these entries to be recorded only for patients (both configuration-wise and transaction-wise). However, the recorded data does not appear in the Meal Order List report. If users need to track the information: For Special Food Items, users can refer to the Special Food Requirement Report. For Food Dislikes, there is currently no report available to track this information. ​ Regards, AdeaHub Aida Binti Jamat Professional Application Delivery
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Nur Fadzilah Othman,

In today’s session, we explained the behavior of the Special Food Items and Food Dislikes functions in the Testing Instance.
Currently, the setup and configuration allow these entries to be recorded only for patients (both configuration-wise and transaction-wise). However, the recorded data does not appear in the Meal Order List report.
If users need to track the information:
  • For Special Food Items, users can refer to the Special Food Requirement Report.
  • For Food Dislikes, there is currently no report available to track this information.
​
Regards,
AdeaHub

Professional Application Delivery

helpdesk-ticket.description: 1) The contract (Valid for OPD AND IPD both) should have the option of overall amount limit and period for which this amount limit is valid. Eg. If 5 patient have come from say company NACIL and the overall limit we have entered is Rs. 10 Lakhs then upto Rs. 10 Lakhs the billing for IPD and OPD services will be to NACIL (There should not be restriction on episode) and beyond Rs. 10 Lakhs it should charge to patient and also it should be period specific i.e. in the above eg, say if period defined is 1/5/14 to 31/5/14 then the contract shld check both the condition of Rs 10 Lakhs and period from 1/5/14 to 31/5/14 and if either of condition is expired the rest amount shld go to patient payable. 2) Pls note currently it is patient specific and that too it is one episode restricted, but we need TPA/Corporate company specific and no restriction on episode (i.e. valid for OPD & IPD both).

helpdesk-ticket.description: Deposit - Carry Forward 1) Currently, patient specific excess deposit is not allowed to be Carry forward to next admission or for OPD episode. (i.e. say If 5 patients are having excess deposit and out of which only 2 says they want to carry forward than system is not allowing to do so) 2) A) KH requires, it should be allowed to carry forward (patient specific) to next admission or can be used for OPD episode, if the refund of the excess amount is not given to patient. B) Also, in the discharge bill it should show the amount that the patient has carry forward the excess amount and the same should be reflected in the next episode of the patient under the description brought forward and its amount. Note: System should allow either whole or part of the refund amount to be carried forward to the next episode.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Package - Definition-Discount
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Deposit - Carry Forward
1) Currently, patient specific excess deposit is not allowed to be Carry forward to next admission or for OPD episode. (i.e. say If 5 patients are having excess deposit and out of which only 2 says they want to carry forward than system is not allowing to do so)
2) A) KH requires, it should be allowed to carry forward (patient specific) to next admission or can be used for OPD episode, if the refund of the excess amount is not given to patient.
B) Also, in the discharge bill it should show the amount that the patient has carry forward the excess amount and the same should be reflected in the next episode of the patient under the description brought forward and its amount.
Note: System should allow either whole or part of the refund amount to be carried forward to the next episode.

helpdesk-ticket.description: NMC-JD-CRF-0259 - Â As per NPHIES latest requirement, Claims should be submitted Encounter-wise and Pre-auth reference wise but not by invoice-wise NPHIES Statutory requirement. This needs to be addressed urgently. As per the current design of the EM-NPHIES integration solution, Claims can be submitted either by Invoice number or Bundle of Bundle. But, all the payers raised the concerns now and issued a warning letter to NMC customer that this approach increased their workload and manpower and this is not acceptable. NPHIES asked to get the claims by Encouter-wise and Pre-auth reference wise. Hence, please change the solution and provide the option to submit the claims by Encounter-wise, Pre-auth reference wise. Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-CRF-0259 - As per NPHIES latest requirement, Claims should be submitted Encounter-wise and Pre-auth reference wise but not by invoice-wise

Reporting an issue with the SHSADTDLL.dll & INQProcessorService-OAS_INQ-HMXP.exe program/file.

Description of Issue Client reported the INQProcessorService-OAS_INQ-HMXP.exe was not processing the messages and the messages are stuck at Pending status. After client restarted the service, the messages are processed.

Cause of the Issue Need developer analysis.
Replication Steps Unable to replicate.

Best regards Alex Yong Healthcare Delivery Dedalus Singapore Pte Ltd

Dear Sara & Naga
Reporting an issue with the Dispensing.exe program/file.
Client Code: SKCH Program: Dispensing.exe Program version: 9.8.11.373 Issue Priority: Low Master Ticket #: MST0106100<https://dedalusprod.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=sn_customerservice_master_ticket.do?sys_id=51aba73e476f26103ee6b1af016d43ba>
Issue Summary When a user dispenses a SCM order for a drug, MaxCare applies the incorrect template instructions.
Details
* The user expects MaxCare to use the template instructions associated with code '73', but instead, it uses the template with code '024'. * However, when the user manually dispenses the same drug, MaxCare correctly uses the '73' template. * This indicates an inconsistency between SCM order dispensing and manual dispensing processes.
Expected Behavior MaxCare should consistently apply the correct template instructions (code '73') regardless of whether the drug is dispensed via SCM order or manually.
Findings on the Issue
1. The instructions templates share the same sequence number ('0').
[A screenshot of a computer AI-generated content may be incorrect.]
1. No default template instructions assigned for the 'SOL' drug form.
[A white box with black text AI-generated content may be incorrect.]
Cause of the Issue Please confirm if the root cause of this issue is due to different queries being used to retrieve the drug instruction template when dispensing via an SCM order versus manual dispensing. This discrepancy may be leading MaxCare to select the incorrect template (code '024') during SCM dispensing, while correctly selecting template '73' during manual dispensing.
Replication Steps Please see the attached document.
Best regards Alex Yong Healthcare Delivery Dedalus Singapore Pte Ltd

Client Code: SKCH
Program: Dispensing.exe
Program version: 9.8.11.373
Issue Priority: Low
Master Ticket #: MST0106100
 
Issue Summary

Details
  • The user expects MaxCare to use the template instructions associated with code ‘73’, but instead, it uses the template with code ‘024’.

helpdesk-note.body: จากการตรวจสอบข้อมูลของผู้ป่วย HN50286444 AN57967305 - ผู้ป่วย Admit วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น.และมีการบันทึก Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. - ทำการย้ายเตียงผู้ป่วยวันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น.โดยใช้ฟังก์ชัน Intra-Ward Patient Transfer จากเตียงหมายเลข 001519 ไปเตียงหมายเลข 001520 และทำการ Reserve เตียงหมายเลข 001519 วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น. - ฟังก์ชัน Release Blocked/Reserved Bed แสดงข้อมูล Reserve เตียงหมายเลข 001519 คือ Blocked From วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น. Blocked Until วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. ( Blocked Until จะแสดงข้อมูลชอง Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) หากไม่ได้บันทึกจะไม่มีข้อมูลแสดง) - กรณีผู้ป่วยรายนี้มีการบันทึก Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. ดังนั้นเตียงหมายเลข 001519 จะถูก Reserved ถึงวันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น เมื่อครบตามวันเวลาที่ระบุ ระบบจะทำการ Release Reserved Bed ให้อัตโนมัติ ดังนั้นหาก User เข้าดูข้อมูลการ Reserved เตียงที่ฟังก์ชัน Release Blocked/Reserved Bed ของเตียงหมายเลข 001519 หลังจากวันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. จึงไม่เห็นข้อมูลการ Reserved ของเตียงหมายเลข 001519 และการคิดค่าสำรองเตียงเป็นไปตาม Policy ของทางศิริราช
helpdesk-note.body-html:
จากการตรวจสอบข้อมูลของผู้ป่วย HN50286444  AN57967305  
 - ผู้ป่วย Admit วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น.และมีการบันทึก Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น.
 - ทำการย้ายเตียงผู้ป่วยวันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น.โดยใช้ฟังก์ชัน Intra-Ward Patient Transfer จากเตียงหมายเลข 001519 ไปเตียงหมายเลข 001520 
 และทำการ Reserve เตียงหมายเลข 001519 วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น. 
 - ฟังก์ชัน Release Blocked/Reserved Bed แสดงข้อมูล Reserve เตียงหมายเลข 001519 คือ Blocked From วันที่ 29 มค 2569 เวลา 14.51 น. Blocked Until วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น.
 ( Blocked Until จะแสดงข้อมูลชอง Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) หากไม่ได้บันทึกจะไม่มีข้อมูลแสดง)   
 - กรณีผู้ป่วยรายนี้มีการบันทึก Expected Discharge Date/Time (EDD) วันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. ดังนั้นเตียงหมายเลข 001519 จะถูก Reserved ถึงวันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น 
 เมื่อครบตามวันเวลาที่ระบุ ระบบจะทำการ Release Reserved Bed ให้อัตโนมัติ ดังนั้นหาก User เข้าดูข้อมูลการ Reserved เตียงที่ฟังก์ชัน Release Blocked/Reserved Bed ของเตียงหมายเลข 001519 หลังจากวันที่ 30 มค 2569 เวลา 13.18 น. จึงไม่เห็นข้อมูลการ Reserved ของเตียงหมายเลข 001519 และการคิดค่าสำรองเตียงเป็นไปตาม Policy ของทางศิริราช

helpdesk-ticket.description: Request to change payment mode PERMOHONAN PEMBETULAN CARA BAYARAN KAD DEBIT KEPADA KAD KREDIT BAGI KUTIPAN HASIL PADA 30 JANUARI 2026 Dengan hormatnya merujuk perkara di atas. 2. Saya, Mohd Fairul Hisham Bin Mohd Rosli memohon maaf kerana telah tersilap memasukkan cara bayaran Kad Kredit kepada Kad Debit bagi kutipan hasil pada 30 Januari 2026 semasa bertugas lebih masa di kaunter hasil HTA. 3. Kesilapan saya ini menyebabkan Laporan Kutipan Hasil pada 30 Januari 2026 tidak tele dengan Butiran Kod dalam Sistem HIS-LIVE dan Sistem Kewangan iGFMAS. 4. Saya memohon Unit IT agar dapat membuat pembetulan pada cara bayaran resit WKRST/26018513 daripada Kad Debit kepada Kad Kredit dalam Laporan Kutipan Hasil seperti yang tertera di lampiran bagi menjamin keseimbangan laporan dalam Sistem HIS-LIVE, Sistem Kewangan iGFMAS dan seterusnya bagi tujuan audit. 5. Segala kesulitan amat dikesali. Saya akan memastikan kesilapan ini tidak berulang lagi di masa akan datang dan saya telah merujuk Unit Hasil HTA untuk penambahbaikan tentang proses cara kerja. Sekian, terima kasih. ‘BERKHIDMAT UNTUK NEGARA’ Saya Yang Menjalankan Amanah, (MOHD FAIRUL HISHAM BIN MOHD ROSLI) Unit Hasil, Hospital Tunku Azizah
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Request to change payment mode
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Request to change payment mode

PERMOHONAN PEMBETULAN CARA BAYARAN KAD DEBIT KEPADA KAD KREDIT BAGI KUTIPAN HASIL PADA 30 JANUARI 2026

Dengan hormatnya merujuk perkara di atas.

2. Saya, Mohd Fairul Hisham Bin Mohd Rosli memohon maaf kerana telah tersilap             memasukkan cara bayaran Kad Kredit kepada Kad Debit bagi kutipan hasil pada 30 Januari 2026 semasa bertugas lebih masa di kaunter hasil HTA.

3. Kesilapan saya ini menyebabkan Laporan Kutipan Hasil pada 30 Januari 2026 tidak tele dengan Butiran Kod dalam Sistem HIS-LIVE dan Sistem Kewangan iGFMAS.
 
4. Saya memohon Unit IT agar dapat membuat pembetulan pada cara bayaran resit WKRST/26018513 daripada Kad Debit kepada Kad Kredit dalam Laporan Kutipan Hasil seperti yang tertera di lampiran bagi menjamin keseimbangan laporan dalam Sistem HIS-LIVE, Sistem Kewangan iGFMAS dan seterusnya bagi tujuan audit.

5. Segala kesulitan amat dikesali. Saya akan memastikan kesilapan ini tidak berulang lagi di masa akan datang dan saya telah merujuk Unit Hasil HTA untuk penambahbaikan tentang proses cara kerja.

Sekian, terima kasih.

‘BERKHIDMAT UNTUK NEGARA’ 
Saya Yang Menjalankan Amanah,
(MOHD FAIRUL HISHAM BIN MOHD ROSLI)
Unit Hasil,
Hospital Tunku Azizah
